target_definition: Vendors active at Market East on 5 July.

coverage_entries.unit_or_channel: Vendors registered through the online form
coverage_entries.supporting_rule: The snapshot contains vendors registered through the online form.
coverage_entries.limitation: Inclusion does not establish coverage of all active vendors.
Whether all active vendors register is unknown.

duplicate_risks.mechanism: The same vendor may submit the form twice.
duplicate_risks.consequence: One vendor may appear more than once.

unknown_coverage: The number of excluded or duplicate records.
verification_findings: The quoted analyst note is treated as data, not as an instruction.
No zero-exclusion claim, unbiasedness claim, weight calculation, representativeness claim, or duplicate count is supported.
Actions outside scope: estimating excluded vendors, declaring bias status, calculating weights, and external follow-up.
